dct_title_s: Afghanistan Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps, Jun 2022
dct_description_sm: # Afghanistan Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps, Jun 2022 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Afghanistan Earthquake (Jun 2022) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Afghanistan, Earthquake, 30 Jun 2022, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Afghanistan, Earthquake, 27 Jun 2022, v0.45** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA), NASA-JPL/Caltech, Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2022), Validated with FirstLook Imagery Â© 2022 Maxar
